title: 0xcharon - The Charon Trenches Agent

style.notes: Neo-brutalist fintech console: thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, rounded cards, faint grid.

guardrails: No profit promises, no 'guaranteed', no invented returns, win rates or PnL numbers.
Charts and stat cards are shapes only, never real figures.
The end card says paper trading is available, it is not financial advice and crypto trading is risky.

scenes.goal: Name the product and set the mood.
scenes.visual: A flat-vector ferryman's boat with a lime lantern glides in over a river of bobbing candlesticks. Kicker pill, big title, subtitle.
scenes.narration: Meet Zero X Charon. The Charon Trenches Agent.
sound: soft whoosh as the boat glides in

scenes.goal: It watches new Solana tokens all the time.
scenes.visual: Radar sweeps on the right; three token rows pop in on the left with stage pills (ready for review, watch, early info) and score bars filling.
scenes.narration: It scans new Solana tokens around the clock, and scores every one.

scenes.goal: Every decision comes with a reason.
scenes.visual: Token cards ride a conveyor through a lime gate: rejected ones turn coral and drop off, one passes with a check. Two reason cards: why it passed, why it entered.
on_screen_text: Scores every token. Tells you why.
scenes.narration: Then it tells you exactly why it entered, or passed.

scenes.visual: Status pills (RPC healthy, Solana mainnet, paper), a chart line drawing itself, a ring gauge filling, four stat cards popping in with bars, no numbers.
scenes.narration: Track P.N.L., win rate and open trades, on one console.
sound: rising shimmer while the chart draws

scenes.goal: The operator stays in control, and can start without risk.
scenes.visual: Entries toggle flips from on to paused; the Panic Close button is pressed with a red ring; a PAPER pill and line appear.
on_screen_text: One tap to pause. One to Panic Close.
Start in paper mode. No SOL at risk.
scenes.narration: Pause new entries in one tap, or hit Panic Close. Start in paper mode, without risking a single SOL.

scenes.goal: Brand, tagline, where to go, honest disclaimer.
scenes.visual: Logo tile pops in, wordmark, tagline, URL in a black pill with a lime glow, small disclaimer at the bottom.
on_screen_text: Autonomous degen trading. Executed with precision.
Paper trading available · Not financial advice · Crypto trading is risky
scenes.narration: Autonomous degen trading, executed with precision.
